consequence.statement: An installation running cert-manager with --namespace=<namespace> will, after the upgrade, have cert-manager scoped to that single namespace with cluster-scoped controllers disabled, which differs from the previous behavior.
consequence.remediation: If you run cert-manager with --namespace=<namespace>, verify that limiting cert-manager to that single namespace and running without cluster-scoped controllers is the intended operating mode for your installation.

assertion.statement: Running cert-manager with --namespace=<namespace> now limits cert-manager's scope to that single namespace and disables cluster-scoped controllers.
